ACTIONSWARM | 2026-10-26 | Nimbus Labs x Meridian Bank kickoff | Summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs held a kickoff meeting for the Nimbus Ledger Sync pilot for UPI reconciliation, aiming for a go-live date of Monday 30 November 2026. The participants aligned on limiting phase one to UPI reconciliation, discussed security and hosting details, and assigned tasks for onboarding, NDA signing, sandboxes, and data mapping. | Decisions: Pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026.; Phase one is strictly limited to UPI reconciliation; NEFT and IMPS are deferred to phase two.; Customer-managed encryption keys are not supported; keys are managed by Nimbus in AWS KMS. | Tasks: Send the standard mutual NDA to Neha Kapoor by Wednesday 4 November 2026 (unassigned); Write a mapping document detailing field mappings by Monday 16 November 2026 (unassigned)

ACTIONSWARM | 2026-10-31 | Nimbus Labs x Meridian Bank kickoff | Summary: Meridian Bank and Nimbus Labs agreed to launch a pilot of the Nimbus Ledger Sync for UPI reconciliation by November 30, 2026. The meeting established project scope, technical constraints, and a schedule of preparatory tasks including sandbox setup, security reviews, and data mapping. | Decisions: Pilot go-live date is set for Monday 30 November 2026.; Phase one is strictly limited to UPI reconciliation only, excluding NEFT and IMPS.; Customer-managed encryption keys are not supported; keys are managed by Nimbus in AWS KMS.; Primary data hosting will be in AWS Mumbai with a disaster recovery replica in Singapore. | Tasks: Send the standard mutual NDA to Neha Kapoor (unassigned); Set up the sandbox environment and send API credentials to Vikram's team (unassigned); Give the IP ranges needed allowlisted for the UPI feed (unassigned); Write a mapping document detailing Meridian field to Nimbus field mappings (unassigned); Send the names of two analysts for user acceptance testing (unassigned); Prepare anonymised sample transaction files from the given layout (unassigned); Ensure Meera Iyer's accounts are set up by the end of the day (unassigned)
